Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, sr As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, -2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 0.5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerForegroundColor = RGB(255, 0, 0): s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 2
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerBackgroundColor = RGB(0, 128, 255): s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 3
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex = 3: s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 4
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex = 5: s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 5
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex = xlColorIndexNone: s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 6
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex = xlColorIndexNone: s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 7
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerBackgroundColor = RGB(0, 128, 255): sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex = xlColorIndexAutomatic: s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 8
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerStyle = xlMarkerStyleSquare: sr.MarkerBackgroundColor = RGB(1, 2, 3): s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerForegroundColor = -1
    Case 10
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerForegroundColor = 16777216
    Case 11
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkers
        sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex = 57
    Case 12
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 13
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        sr.MarkerBackgroundColor = RGB(0, 128, 255): s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 14
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        sr.MarkerForegroundColor = RGB(255, 0, 0): s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColor & "," & sr.MarkerForegroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerBackgroundColorIndex & "," & sr.MarkerStyle
    Case 15
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        s = sr.MarkerForegroundColor
    Case 16
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.MarkerForegroundColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
    End Select
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 16
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
